$doc: scene-model-spec §6a walk-test: every state a user can SEE on a scene, with the reach counts the rule fixes - editor ≤ 1 action, App settings ≤ 2 actions, Back returns exactly to the scene. Consumed by scripts/walk-test-6a.mjs against the prism:// route registry Agent 3 provides (see that script's header for the registry shape). `actions` name the human gestures §6a lists; a reach entry in the registry must exist from the state to the destination with at most `max` actions.
rule: no state a user can see on a scene may require more than one action to reach its editor and two to reach its App settings; Back always returns to the scene
counting: ACTION COUNT convention (the reading that makes §6a self-consistent with its own long-press example): opening the context sheet on an item - long-press / right-click / remote-hold - is SELECTION and counts 0; every choice or navigation after it counts 1; a direct tap, badge-tap, or corner affordance counts 1. So editor via the sheet = 1 (Edit facet), App settings via the sheet = 1, App settings through the editor = 2 (the ceiling).

states.spec: §6a single tap → full-page native experience; long-press → context sheet
states.visible: a video facet in a slot (e.g. Hulu Live TV 16:9·XL)

fullPage.note: the tap itself is a host call, not a route; the sheet route stands in for the item being addressable

states.spec: §6a long-press → sheet; the sheet's Open the full app reveals the native player (§32) as an inline window (B-146). A tap does nothing (B-145)
states.visible: a visualization whose source is a hidden music facet

editor.note: 2026-09-06: a stage's editor is the visual (pack + artwork), not the hidden facet's page

reveal.note: 2026-09-08: the tap reveal went (it took people into the page with no way to tell Back from App settings); the player opens from the sheet, as an inline window with Prism's menu bar

addService.note: 2026-09-07: a second service joins the lounge; Quick play groups by service and the visual follows the pick

adsSound.note: 2026-09-07: section 26 ambient audio - a soundscape instead of silence during a service's ads

states.spec: §6a the badge is itself the shortcut → prism://app/<id>/setup; sign-in returns to the scene with the facet reloading (§16)
states.visible: a needs-attention badge on any item (App signed out, login redirect, adapter failing)

states.spec: §5 floating facets get the same on-scene interactions as slot facets
states.visible: a floating facet (anchor corner + size fraction) above the slots

states.spec: a hidden facet is not visible on the scene itself; what IS visible is its visualization (music-visualization) or the pill's now-playing card - the pill/card must offer the same sheet
states.visible: the pill / now-playing card for a hidden audio facet

states.spec: §5 missing-assignment slots render the App-poster placeholder, tappable to assign

states.spec: §6a during full-page/reveal a corner affordance (and mapped remote key) offers Edit this facet and App settings
states.visible: a facet promoted to full-page / a revealed native player

states.spec: §6a the compact context sheet: each item a deep link, sheet closes on action, Back returns to the scene
states.visible: the context sheet open over any item
